body_text:
Very poor experience with Swiggy overall. The biggest problem is how they handle customer complaints. Whenever there is an issue with an Instamart product or a food order, Swiggy seems to avoid taking responsibility and makes the customer go through unnecessary trouble to get a resolution.

Their customer support is absolutely no help. They often just ask you to send an email instead of actually resolving the issue. Even worse, they claim that the refund has been processed, but the money never actually gets credited. When you follow up, instead of taking responsibility or properly investigating the issue, they simply blame the bank and say the money is not showing because of the bank’s fault.

Customers should not have to repeatedly follow up, contact their bank, and waste their time just to get their own money back. Swiggy needs to take accountability for faulty, damaged, incorrect, or poor-quality products and services and provide genuine customer support instead of constantly shifting the blame. Extremely disappointing and frustrating experience.
